description: When a covered Vancouver house was built and what stood there: the building permit (1901–1930) and the City's year built, what the 1912 fire insurance map draws on the lot and whether today's building is very likely that one, what stands today, and who lived there in each directory year with each listing's source page, and where the 1911, 1921 and 1931 censuses list households at the address, their people, tenure, rent, rooms, origins and birthplaces (1911 gives only the people, origins and birthplaces; 1931 adds the home's value and a radio) as counts, and in 1921 the people by name as Library and Archives Canada's index gives them, each with its LAC record link. Residents' names through 1945 only; later years show a household and job without names. Anything inferred is marked inferred. A house with more than one answer holds (a hotel or rooming house) answers a summary with every year's count of listings, the latest years in full and each census as its summary; ask again with year for any other directory year or census year.

address.description: A Vancouver street address as written today or in the directories ("620 Keefer St", "2649 Yew"), an AddressLore house path ("620-keefer") or its URL.

page.description: Which page, when an answer says it has more than one (pages, next_page); 1 if left out.

year.description: Only this year: a directory year's listings, a census year's (1911, 1921, 1931) households, or both where a year is both. The house's years are in years_listed and residents.

name: house_history
title: A house's history
